summary: icon.dat's binary content was replaced; the evidence provides only opaque blob hashes for this change, so its visual meaning cannot be determined, and the file's mode is unchanged.

items.title: icon.dat's binary content was replaced
items.statement: icon.dat's content changed between base and head; Shiftory's evidence reports this only as an opaque binary unit identified by differing blob hashes, with no textual diff available.

items.title: The meaning of the new bytes is not available from evidence
items.statement: Because no textual or decoded representation of icon.dat's bytes is available, what the new content actually depicts cannot be determined from this evidence.

items.title: File mode is unchanged
items.statement: Both the old and new file mode are 100644; only the file's content changed, not its permissions or type.
